description_html:
This charming one bedroom flat overlooks the expansive Barbican residents gardens and is being sold chain-free by the current owner.
With both a north and south facing aspect, this bright and spacious one bed flat offers a unique view through the floor to ceiling window, with ample room in the living area for separate lounge and dining spaces.

With both a north and south facing aspect, this bright and spacious one bed flat offers a unique view through the floor to ceiling window, with ample room in the living area for separate lounge and dining spaces.

The flat retains many of its original features in the kitchen and bathroom, with only minor quality of life changes made in the kitchen by way of a partially updated worktop and a new hob.

Thomas More House is located on the western end of the Barbican Estate, a short walk from Barbican tube station and the Farringdon Elizabeth line station located on Long Lane.

Tenure: Leasehold Lease Years Remaining: 80
Service Charge: £5,646 (Yearly)
Annual Ground Rent: £10
Council Tax Band: E
